intent: Watching CI on Draft PR #4203 before the Ready decision
summary: Draft PR #4203 pushed with the clippy fix; waiting on its CI run.
progress_summary: Direct-mode fix for #4191. Measured the step over 60 green runs (p50 29s, p95 60s, max 106s) and concluded a cap raise alone could not fix a stalled mirror. Moved the deadline into scripts/ci-apt.sh (900s total, 3 attempts x 240s, 15s backoff), added a gtk-deps mode owning the package set, an apt archive cache, and a job-summary failure marker; demoted the 5 workflow step caps to an 18-minute outer net. RED observed, then GREEN. Verified the cfg(unix) half in a Linux container: clippy -D warnings clean and 14 contract tests pass. AC-2 proven end to end against real apt (cold 211 MB / 164s, warm Need to get 0 B / 67s). Draft PR #4203 open; first CI run caught a disallowed std::process::Command::new that Windows clippy could not see, fixed and pushed.
